reapack.name: SGM_CoreUtilities_Bundle.lua
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Essentials: mix bus routing, auto-mastering, smart tools, DAW analyzer, and utilities

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.1.2 (2026-11-07) + Bug-fix pass (scripts audited against the ReaScript API): SGM_auto_master 1.0.1, SGM_route_mix_bus 1.0.1, SGM_FieldyBagToggle 1.0.1, daw-discovery-analyzer 1.0.2, SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools 1.0.2 + Docs: removed the toolbar clock / CPU meter / color picker and the Shift+F12 / Ctrl+Alt+U shortcuts, which were never implemented 1.1.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: daw-discovery-analyzer 1.0.1 (GetUserInputs menu, localized functions), SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools 1.0.1 (palette fix, mouse-modifier consent/restore, no global exports) 1.1.0 (2026-06-03) + Reorganised for ReaPack: kept to the utilities I use day to day 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_FieldyBagToggle.lua
reapack.desc: Toggle between Fieldy (Korn) and Dimebag (Pantera) bass FX chains on the selected track

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.1 (2026-11-07) + Fix: no longer writes bypass state to FX slots that do not exist + Fix: no undo point when nothing was actually toggled + Fix: reports "No FX found on selected track." as documented 1.0.0 (2026-06-02) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_auto_master.lua
reapack.desc: Auto-mastering chain using REAPER stock plugins: EQ, compression, saturation, and limiting

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.1 (2026-11-07) + Fix: stock limiter is "ReaLimit" (was "ReaLimiter", so no limiter was inserted) + Fix: ReaEQ high-pass now configured with TrackFX_SetEQParam instead of writing raw values into the wrong parameter indices + Fix: ReaComp / ReaLimit parameters are found by name, not hard-coded index + Add: the HPF_FREQ / COMP_* / LIMIT_CEIL constants the docs always promised 1.0.0 (2026-06-02) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools.lua
reapack.desc: 4K-friendly REAPER theme generator with WCAG contrast checking and an optional smart-tool cursor engine

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: smart tools passed numeric ids to SetMouseModifier(), which only accepts mouse-modifier / action ID strings; it could corrupt the user's mouse modifiers + Fix: removed toolbar clock / CPU meter / color picker and Shift+F12 / Ctrl+Alt+U from the docs - they were never implemented + Fix: a failed theme write is now reported instead of printed as success 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: add missing ThemeMetadata.palette (fixes crash in install_theme) + Top Shelf audit: save/restore mouse modifier; confirm before smart tools start + Top Shelf audit: localize functions, remove _G exports (no global leaks) 1.0.0 (2026-06-02) + Initial release

reapack.name: SGM_route_mix_bus.lua
reapack.desc: Route all tracks through a Mix Bus, then Mix Bus to Master

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.1 (2026-11-07) + Fix: track selection is honoured (previously every top-level track was routed) + Fix: nested tracks inside folders are no longer skipped + Fix: a track named "Mix Bus" is not mistaken for the bus when an existing bus is reused + Fix: no dangling undo point or UI refresh when there is nothing to do + Add: console message when nothing is selected 1.0.0 (2026-06-03) + Initial release

reapack.name: daw-discovery-analyzer.lua
reapack.desc: Profile the REAPER environment: plugins, routing graph, track structure, and system specs

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: the report used the non-existent reaper.GetCPULoading() and crashed; now uses reaper.GetCPUUsage() with a safe fallback + Fix: audio bit depth queried "BITDEPTH"; the API key is "BPS" + Fix: without SWS, routing edges all pointed at "master"; now uses the built-in P_DESTTRACK API for the real destinations + Fix: SWS detection now checks the routing function actually used + Fix: the config monitor now starts from a captured baseline 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs + Top Shelf audit: localize main functions (no global leaks) 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release + System profiling: CPU, RAM, sample rate, buffer size + Plugin discovery and categorization + Signal flow graph generation exported to console

reapack.name: SGM_RuleOf30_Bundle.lua
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Rule of 30 heavy metal production bundle: 48-track session, plugin presets, and phase alignment

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Bug-fix pass: session builder no longer crashes when building without a plugin inventory, sidechain sends are guarded and deduplicated, tempo marker handling fixed, phase tool no longer leaves the UI frozen on early exit + Docs: the preset file is a reference library, not a runtime dependency 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: undo/PUIR on all session-builder actions, GetUserInputs menus, localized helpers (session-builder 1.0.1, phase-alignment-tool 1.0.1, plugin-presets 1.0.1) 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release

reapack.name: phase-alignment-tool.lua
reapack.desc: Auto-align quad-tracked DI guitars by transient analysis before amp processing

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix: early exits left UIRefresh disabled and an undo block open + Fix: transient detection read a multi-channel buffer as if it were mono + Fix: hard-coded 48 kHz in the reports (now uses the project sample rate) + Fix: reported peak stopped accumulating once a transient was found 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release + Transient onset detection on selected DI tracks + Sample-accurate offset calculation and item nudge + Designed for quad-tracked guitars in heavy metal production

reapack.name: rule-of-30-session-builder.lua
reapack.desc: Build a 48-track industrial/heavy metal session: Drop Bb, 95-110 BPM, massive density

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: 1.0.2 (2026-11-07) + Fix (fatal): the plugin-aware builder called addFX() before it was declared, so building with Compact Mode off raised "attempt to call a nil value" + Fix (fatal): CreateTrackSend() returning -1 made the send setters error + Fix: the master track keeps its master/parent send + Fix: plugin_inventory.json is looked for next to the script (was hard-coded to the REAPER resource root) + Fix: sidechain sends reuse an existing Kick Out -> Bass send + Fix: an existing tempo marker is updated instead of adding a new one + Fix: menu option 7 (Close) no longer falls through silently 1.0.1 (2026-10-08) + Top Shelf audit: undo + PreventUIRefresh on all six actions + Top Shelf audit: replace gfx.showmenu with GetUserInputs 1.0.0 (2026-05-23) + Initial release + 48+ track template: quad guitars, double bass, full drum kit, orchestral layers + Drop Bb tuning, 95-110 BPM range + Bus architecture with parallel compression sends
